note: Core method (docs/SIMPLIFICATION_PLAN.md Phase 1); implemented in backend/app/astro/core.py. House-judgement points reuse bhava.py BH.* rules; MD-AD friction reuses dasha_craft DC.AD_FROM_MD.*.

rules.source: BPHS ch.11-24 (bhava phala) and ch.32 (karakas) via bhava.judge_house (BH.* rules); Phaladeepika ch.15
rules.conditions: Topic primary house judged by its lord's placement (kendra/trikona good; 6/8/12 weak unless Viparita), dignity, combustion, Shadbala vs BPHS minimum, occupants and aspects (benefic/malefic), SAV, D9 lord (only if D9 reliable) and Bhava Bala. Lagna view weight 1, Moon view 0.5, averaged. Grade on the combined score: strong >= 3.0, weak < 1.0 (app convention).
exceptions: Birth time unknown: Moon view only, Shadbala and Bhava Bala dropped

rules.source: Standard Parashari practice: Chandra Lagna as a secondary ascendant (chapter reference not yet verified)
rules.conditions: Houses re-counted from the natal Moon sign and judged with the same BH.* rules; secondary weight 0.5, sole reference when the birth time is unknown.
House lord's functional role from the Lagna: yogakaraka +1, Lagna lord or benefic by lordship +0.5, malefic by lordship -0.5.
exceptions: Not used when the birth time is unknown

rules.conditions: House lord in a friendly (adhimitra/friend) sign +0.5, unfriendly (enemy/adhishatru) -0.5, only when it has no exaltation/own/debilitation dignity.
Topic karakas other than the house karaka already scored by bhava.py: strong +0.5, weak -0.5 (strength summary, else sign dignity). Nodes not scored.
Active yogas (status == 'active') whose houses include a topic house or whose participants include the house lord: +0.5 each, at most +1.
exceptions: Not used when the birth time is unknown

rules.source: BPHS ch.6-7 (divisional charts and their significations)
rules.conditions: House lord exalted/own in the topic varga +0.5, debilitated -0.5; only when varga_reliability for that varga is 'reliable'.

rules.source: BPHS dasha phala chapters (ch.46-62: results by the dasha lord's lordship and placement); K.N. Rao linking practice
rules.conditions: MD/AD/PD lord links to topic houses (Lagna weight 1, Moon 0.5): owns, occupies, aspects, conjunct the house lord, nakshatra lord owns/occupies, node dispositor. Primary house weighs more. AD score = AD links + 0.5 x MD links; strong >= 4, medium >= 2 (app convention). MD-AD friction via DC.AD_FROM_MD.

rules.source: K.N. Rao, double transit of Saturn and Jupiter (Planets and Children / Timing Events through Vimshottari Dasa)
rules.conditions: A month qualifies when transiting Saturn AND Jupiter each occupy or aspect (Parashari drishti) the topic's primary house sign or its lord's natal sign; from the Lagna, and from the Moon as secondary.
Narrowest window: linked PD intersected with double-transit months, else linked AD intersected with transit months, else the strongest linked AD; clipped to the range. Weak promise gives no window.

Points: promise strong 2 / moderate 1; link strong 2 / medium 1; transit 1; birth time approximate -1, unknown -2; topic varga unreliable -1; personal fit good +1, poor -2. Timing: high >= 5, medium >= 3; natal: high >= 3, medium >= 1. Unknown time or poor fit caps at low.
Card: verdict likely (linked period + transit) / mixed / not_indicated (natal: strong/moderate/weak), <= 2 plain reasons with fact IDs, one action line from a per-topic table (no remedies, no fear).
Past questions scan backward (default last 15 years) and return linked periods (with transit where present) as candidates, most recent first.
